PluginLibraryModule.cards.title: English Learning Workbench
PluginLibraryModule.cards.descriptionZh: 英语学习工作台：名著原文点读、新闻与 TED 导读、粘贴文章精读、可选的每日外刊，配词句库与间隔复习、跟读录音和考试微练。
PluginLibraryModule.cards.shortDescription: A daily desk for reading English.
PluginLibraryModule.cards.shortDescriptionZh: 点读、跟读、词句库与每日练习。

quickStart.prompt: Add a fourth book to the English workbench's classics: two passages from the public-domain text of Jane Eyre, with annotated words and a Chinese translation, in the same format as the other books.
quickStart.promptZh: 在英语学习工作台的「名著轻阅读」里加第四本书：《简·爱》公版原文里的两段，配标注词和中文译文，格式和其他书一样。
